name: Lucia Annunziata - Proposition de résolution
title: REPORT on flagship European defence projects of common interest
part_text:
The European Parliament sets out what it wants from four planned joint defence projects: a drone defence system, a watch on the EU's eastern border, an air shield and a space shield. It asks for clear goals, timelines and money for each, more joint buying of defence equipment, and a bigger role for smaller companies and Ukraine. It also wants Parliament to oversee the spending. This is the Parliament's position, not a new law.

- Four flagship projects proposed: drone defence, eastern border watch, air and space shields; details and funding still to be agreed.
- Affects EU governments, defence firms, small companies and Ukraine; Parliament wants wider participation and joint procurement.
- Next: the Commission and member states must come back with concrete plans, timelines and funding under the next EU long-term budget.
